learner_decisions.summary: Proposed attendance buffer for this plan
learner_decisions.rationale: Propose 15 additional people above the captured basis of 245. Allow for some forecast error while keeping the supported catering packages comparable. This is a plan-specific proposal to reconsider after confirmed attendance changes.
tradeoffs: A larger buffer protects against forecast error and can increase waste
The chosen buffer requires both catering and venue capacity

learner_decisions.summary: Recommend a supported option or defer
learner_decisions.rationale: Among feasible options prefer greater catering coverage, then lower total cost. This spends more for shortage protection while preserving the overall ceiling.
tradeoffs: Greater catering coverage reduces shortage exposure but costs more
Retain the lower-cost alternative and its remaining budget for review

accessibility_baseline.summary: For this case, venue coordination confirms step-free access between the 4F accessible elevators, audience area, V.I.P. Room and accessible restroom. The public floor plan supplies spatial locators; it does not prove today's elevator operation, unobstructed route, seating configuration or acoustic performance. Those case conditions are supplied by this fictional coordination record, and a real deployment must obtain current confirmation rather than treat this exercise note as evidence about TICC.

The package includes setup and teardown access, the quiet space and its separation from the programme. QuietWorks supplies staffing under Q-010; ClearText supplies captions under Q-005. Q-003/Q-004 catering and Q-006/Q-007 AV are fictional TICC-coordinated service offers, not permission to bring external food or equipment. StreamNorth Q-008 still requires its stated network test and venue confirmation before use. The exercise record confirms adequate captioning, hearing-loop and allergy coordination for the base plan using Q-004/Q-005/Q-006/Q-010; both catering options include an Operations-coordinated dietary response for the 28 vegetarian meals, 12 halal meals and four severe-allergy requests. Named contacts are held by Operations; the learner records the response state without inventing or publishing personal medical details. The two menus differ in capacity and cost, not in whether safety may be ignored.

hard_constraints.summary: Hard requirements are step-free access to the main programme and restrooms, wheelchair seating, live captions, a staffed quiet room, a 09:30 opening, and completion by 17:00. The total approved planning ceiling is TWD 520000. The recommendation must not assume an expired quote or unconfirmed availability.
Success means at least 80 percent of registered attendees check in, all scheduled fellow demos run, and accessibility requests receive a documented response before the event.
